description: Official 13-step physical experiment procedure for ORBITA offline AI copilot.

steps.label: Identify the Blue Box
steps.description: Locate and identify the Blue Box in the workspace.

steps.label: Pick up the Blue Box
steps.description: Grasp and lift the Blue Box from the table.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 2. Pick up the Blue Box.

steps.label: Place Blue Box at Location A
steps.description: Place the Blue Box down at designated Location A.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 3. Place the Blue Box at Location A.
steps.completion_voice: Blue Box placed at Location A.

steps.label: Identify the Yellow Box
steps.description: Locate and identify the Yellow Box in the workspace.

steps.label: Pick up the Yellow Box
steps.description: Grasp and lift the Yellow Box from the table.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 5. Pick up the Yellow Box.

steps.label: Place Yellow Box at Location B
steps.description: Place the Yellow Box down at designated Location B.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 6. Place the Yellow Box at Location B.
steps.completion_voice: Yellow Box placed at Location B.

steps.label: Place Pen inside the Blue Box
steps.description: Insert the pen inside the Blue Box at Location A.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 8. Place the Pen inside the Blue Box.
steps.completion_voice: Pen placed inside the Blue Box.

steps.label: Place Watch inside the Yellow Box
steps.description: Insert the watch inside the Yellow Box at Location B.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 10. Place the Watch inside the Yellow Box.
steps.completion_voice: Watch placed inside the Yellow Box.

steps.label: Move Blue Box from A to B
steps.description: Move the Blue Box from Location A across to Location B.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 11. Move the Blue Box from Location A to Location B.
steps.completion_voice: Blue Box moved to Location B.

steps.label: Move Yellow Box from B to A
steps.description: Move the Yellow Box from Location B across to Location A.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 12. Move the Yellow Box from Location B to Location A.
steps.completion_voice: Yellow Box moved to Location A.

steps.label: Experiment Complete
steps.voice_prompt: Experiment complete. All steps were successfully completed.
steps.completion_voice: Experiment complete. All steps were successfully completed.

completion_message: Experiment complete. All steps were successfully completed.
